summary: Refactored goal status rendering to a compact hierarchy for CLI and Telegram using shared compact-output primitives: state headline, progress, blocker, retry summary, capped top-step list with attempt badges, and Telegram line-budget enforcement. Updated goal-status command to default to concise/no-diagram text while keeping optional diagram rendering, wired Telegram /goal_status to channel-aware compact mode, and refreshed tests for status layout, retries, step caps, and Telegram options. Verified with lint, build, focused vitest suites, and runtime smoke checks via local CLI for done and blocked runs.
